basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a high school junior from Indiana who recently got into the world of Reddit. I love playing video games, especially Among Us and other multiplayer games. I'm fascinated by true crime stories and food safety tips, which is why you'll often find me browsing those subreddits. My typical online hours are in the evenings after school and during weekends. I work part-time at a local fast-food joint, which has made me more interested in food safety. I'm currently single, but I enjoy hanging out with my friends online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of school education and self-taught interests. I've learned a lot about food safety from both my job and internet resources. As a teenager, I'm constantly learning new things from YouTube and Reddit, especially about gaming strategies and true crime cases.
